name: CASHPIRE SMP | ECONOMY & SURVIVAL [1.21.11]
description:
⚔️ Welcome to Cashpire SMP: Build Your Kingdom. Claim Your Glory. ⚔️

Join an active community of 50+ players every day on a server with three ways to play, all open to both Java and Bedrock players.

👑 Kingdoms SMP

Explore a world with 190+ custom biomes you won’t find anywhere else. Found your own kingdom, recruit members, and build it into a power. Venture into the Resource Zone to gather materials, then go to war and battle rival kingdoms for dominance.

❤️ Lifesteal SMP

Every kill steals a heart and every death costs you one. Fight, survive, and climb to the top.

💰 Economy SMP

Trade, build your fortune, and run your own shops in a player-driven economy.

✨ Why play with us?

• 50+ players online at peak every day

• Friendly, active staff who are here to help

• Java & Bedrock crossplay

• Vote rewards for supporting the server
